title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay 1 Town Proper, Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar to Be Known as the Catubig Valley National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay 1 Town Proper, Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar to Be Known as the Catubig Valley National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ 1 Town Proper, เทศบาล Catubig, จังหวัด Northern Samar ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Catubig Valley

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay 1, Town Proper, Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar to be known as the Catubig Valley National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
